title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin

extraction.summaryEn: Several incidents of damage to election posters across Berlin on the evening and night before the state parliament election were reported; the Staatsschutz is investigating. One suspect was arrested after a man struck posters with a pole, and a poster bearing a Nazi symbol was found in Weißensee.
